chapter: Tulsa bands, Trent, Holder and Kirk
title: How the taxi dance worked
summary: Fields explains the ten-cents-a-dance system and paying bands on percentage.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Before you go on, would you like to explain how the taxi dance worked?

What it was is you would go into a place and the guy would tell you that you've got to do so many dances an hour, to figure out the money he's going to make, and it's ten cents a dance. You've got to be on your P's and Q's. If I remember right, I believe no dance could be over three minutes.
Yes and they had the girls, they paid the girls to come and he's selling tickets.
Yes. If they were really going good, they're going to pay you, but a lot of them were on percentage.
